requirements.text: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
3–5 years of Salesforce development experience, including building and customizing Salesforce Health Cloud or related Service Cloud/Sales Cloud solutions.
Working knowledge of Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components, and Salesforce APIs.
Experience integrating Salesforce with external systems using REST/SOAP APIs and middleware platforms.
Solid understanding of object-oriented programming principles and design patterns.
Hands-on experience with JavaScript/Node.js, including debugging RESTful web services or front-end frameworks (e.g., React).
Prior experience working directly with clients or Client Success teams, with strong analytical and communication skills.

Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements (including HL7, HIPAA, where applicable)
Bring working familiarity with AWS and containerized environments (Docker, Kubernetes/OpenShift) to help resolve cross-stack technical issues, partnering with Engineering, Product, and DevOps.
Must work in the EST (Eastern Standard Time) time zone and be comfortable coordinating with an India-based support team.
Salesforce certifications (e.g., Platform Developer I/II, Health Cloud Consultant) preferred but not required.
